criteria.description: Infants aged one year or younger.
Participants exclusively older than one year or nonhuman studies.
No nirsevimab intervention, or nirsevimab used only in combination with another intervention.
No placebo comparator; active comparator alone is ineligible.
Nonrandomized studies, reviews, meta-analyses or other reports not reporting a randomized trial.
Published from database inception through June 2022 inclusive.
Written in English or available in English translation.
Confirmed no English report or English translation; unknown translation availability alone is insufficient to exclude.

RSV illness, RSV-related hospitalization, any respiratory illness, life-threatening or fatal adverse events, or adverse events of special interest including hypersensitivity, immune-complex disease and thrombocytopenia.
Reports confirmed to report only outcomes outside review scope. Missing title/abstract outcome information alone is insufficient to exclude.

notes: 依据用户指定的 DE V3 Turalde Protocol Source 投影。June 2022 按月末规范化为 2022-06-30。题录由用户外部提供；本 Run 不执行或验证原检索。标题摘要信息缺失不等同于明确不合格，保留进入全文核查；不读取 Review 结果或 Benchmark Reference。
research_question: In infants aged one year or younger, how does nirsevimab compare with placebo for preventing respiratory syncytial virus infection and related illness, and what are its safety outcomes?
title: Efficacy and safety of nirsevimab for the prevention of respiratory syncytial virus infection among infants
